notes.title: Hotfix: 01112020 False Positives and The Dreaded ESC Key
notes.notes:
[h1]For some of you having problems you can now play Succubus Hunter! (Hopefully)[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38141552/6fa65dd9620a92c6b739d48259373989214c23f3.png[/img]

[h2]Succubus Hunter causing false positives[/h2]

Some people have reporting that their anti virus software was triggering the anti virus for certain people's computers. This seems to be an issue with Click Team Fusion[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/388090/discussions/0/364041517010867120/] (Scott had the same issues with Five Night At Freddy's)[/url]

After some long talks it (seems) that this has been resolved for some software and Succubus Hunter should no longer trigger them.

The game may still behave strangely with antivirus software . We are still researching solutions. 

[h2]ESC shutting th game off instantly.[/h2]

While some people have told others "Lol dude... just don't press the escape key!", we do understand that this is a potential issue for many. Pressing ESC will no longer shut the games down. 

[h2]A "muting" option[/h2]

For those that don't want to hear the fancy tunes we came up with (it's fineeee music is subjective) we have told libraheart to put in a mute function until we can get proper sound setting implemented. Just press the "M" key for all 3 titles and you can now listen to whatever you want unencumbered while play the title.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38141552/af81201992ed3936fbe4a1c5e9c64fea7a24c65e.png[/img]

We know there some little issues that we will still have to work out with with Libraheart like s such has people having controller issues due to the game not smart switching, but this is (surprisingly a larger issue that will require some time.)

Thanks for being patient with us! Anyway you can  go back and to doing... succing?

notes.title: Tower and Sword - Day 1 Report
notes.notes:
[h1]Big thanks for the support everyone![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38141552/524f2b9b0b5495edc149008a286b4408f18af7f6.png[/img]

Things have been going pretty well for this title since launch and we are happy to get this nice Libraheart bundle to all of you. Of course we have ran into a few issues and some useful feedback that we would like to acknowledged and in tern report to the Japanese devs about. 

[h1]Reported Issues[/h1]

Some Day 1 bugs have been addressed (perhaps issues that have been there for a while). Let's talk about them and what the plans are for the future. 

[b]- Minor amount of players a reporting controller issues. At the moment the games don't smart switch between keyboard and gamepad controls. If you want to use the keyboard please remove the gamepad at launch.

- At the moment the game doesn't support key mapping and some other important options. We as we said in our previous announcement this is some of the QOL things that we will do over time. As with what was done with Midnight Castle.

- Putting the game on an external harddrive tends to cause slow down and frame dips

- Apparently the debug room can be accessed in Sword (lol). This will be fixed in the future.
  Edit: Nevermind. We'll keep it in... [/b]

For a lot of these doujin devs in japan they have never been exposed to such a large audience with a diverse set of systems nor do they usually get much feedback when there are issues with players. We knew full well there would be some problems and we will get them addressed accordingly as fast as possible. 

[h1]Things are looking good![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38141552/6fa65dd9620a92c6b739d48259373989214c23f3.png[/img]

Apart from that its seems most of you guys are happy! Which makes us happy too! The sales for [i][b]Tower and Sword will exceeded what both of these games did separately on DLSITE (English and Japanese) in their lifetime in the next few hours.[/b][/i]

For those of you having a grand old time fucking things to death(?), [i][b]please take some time to leave a review! (Yes this includes the funny ones.)[/b][/i] 

As some of you guys know [b][i]adult games get reduced visibility here on Steam so every bit counts for AO titles![/i][/b] So this is very much appreciated gesture. Thanks for the support guys! Look forward for even more Libraheart in the near future.

notes.title: Tower and Sword (and Succubus Hunter) To Arrive In a Few Hours!
notes.notes:
[h1]And just in time for Spooktober![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38141552/b2fba06f5aea948490314d9fed43cd2a61132886.png[/img]

[b]We'll be releasing this title in a few hours release at 12.99$ with a 10% discount![/b]

[b]So what is changed in our version of Tower and Sword of Succubus?[/b]

[h2]Uncensored CGs and Animations[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38141552/0259bfa943b9952e461b99797d43c5d5c528cef8.gif[/img]

Tower and Sword had an interesting way of censoring their material buy implementing it well in the game's UI design. This of course though made it [i]MORE [/i]difficult to uncensor. This took a bit of time but now it has been addressed. The Critical Bliss version of these two game will be the definitive experience for now on!

[h2]Difficulty[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38141552/547e1b68009bb8928d26f6854003304a469d732b.png[/img]

We felt that the base game was a bit too easy for some of you Steam veterans so both Tower and Sword has been upped a notch in difficulty. We have also added an addition setting called "Master Mode". Those familiar with recent Zelda games know full well what that means. If you want your skills tested that mode was made just for you... [i][b](with an achievement to get as well![/b][/i])

For those that still prefer an easier time we have the option of playing on the original version as well. Consider that "easy" mode. 

[h2]An original soundtrack made from the ground up.[/h2]

For those that loved what we did with [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1416470/Midnight_Castle_Succubus_Soundtrack/]Midnight Castle Succubus's soundtrack [/url] you are going to love what we did on this as well! Instead of using the royalty free material of the base game, we provided LibraHeart with a whole new OST. Our approach with these two games was a bit different compared to Midnight, but if you have a strong ear you will pick up fast on our musical mannerisms. We hope for people who played this game previously that this provides a refreshing experience. 

The OST for Tower and Sword for both games will also be available on release in one nice package this time! Formats include Mp3 320 and FLAC.

[h2]QOL Improvements and Achievements[/h2]

We have addressed some previous bugs and added some more functionality. [i][b]We plan on doing a bit more in the future to make the experience for people even better.[/b][/i] Achievements has also been added and you can expect trading cards to be done as well in the near future.

[h2]Translations[/h2]

At this very moment LibraHeart is trying to implement translations for the game. He hit a few roadbumps at the finish line so these may not be available at launch. However just like with Midnight Castle Succubus we will be providing Chinese, German, Russian, and Korean as soon as possible. Thanks for you patience. 

****

As with [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1299320/]Midnight Castle Succubus,[/url] we want to thank Libraheart for entrusting their games with us. Thanks for the support guys. Hope you have a great time!

notes.title: Tower and Sword will release uncensored! Free DLC to also be added.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38141552/df44e1898ace8d8cb75644ffecb6f4d9ca23ca33.png[/img]

After... [i][b]A LOT[/b][/i] of convincing and building quite a high amount of wishlist for Libraheart, the dev has agreed to uncensoring the animations and CGs in both Tower and Sword. The plan was to do this [i][b]AFTER[/b][/i] the release of the the game on Steam to prove to Libraheart that it would be worth the effort... however we feel it would be irresponsible as publisher to release this game hastily without these changes.

While uncensoring mosaics can be quite simple to do, Libraheart  built the aesthetic of the game around censorship in the first place in order for the censored content can feel intelligently implemented. This means that making the two games uncensored will take more effort than usual as frames have to be redrawn and reanimated. 

This can take a bit of time and while we would like to release Tower and Sword at the end of this month, we don't feel comfortable giving a release window to this game yet until the editing process is accomplished.

With the addition of a replacing the royalty free music with an authentic original ost by the Critical Bliss sound team, our version of Tower and Sword will be the definitive version that international users can acquire!

And it only gets better for here...

[h1] We are planning to have Succubus Hunter bundled for free as DLC for Tower and Sword.[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38141552/28f5930d004a7bef0fc5bc9edf19495bb19cbd1a.png[/img]

Libraheart's gameboy inspired title [i]Succubus Hunter[/i] will now be added to the amount of content you  will receive on launch. The game is currently getting reviewed by Steam and we will let you guys know when it passes approval so you can look forward to getting your hands on 3 games in one!

I'm sure a lot of you will be happy to hear this news! Thanks for sticking with us!
